verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a broad OpenAI-compatible API (plus the Anthropic Messages and Open Responses APIs) and a /models/apply endpoint for installing models, so core inference and model installation are reachable programmatically. However, the built-in web UI also manages agents and other configuration, and nothing documents API parity for those, or states that the UI is a thin layer over the API. Probes also found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API endpoints for agent configuration and user/admin management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
LocalAI also supports the **Anthropic Messages API**, the **Open Responses API**, and more.
LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
